statement: Build a single-file website for Brew Lab, a small specialty coffee shop, showing its name, address and menu, and letting customers send a pre-order for pickup at the shop.
audience: Local customers in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, mostly on phones, who want to see the menu and pre-order for pickup.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Works on phones, with no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px
The website agrees with the PRD, HLD and LLD documents
rules: Do not show a shop phone number
Do not embed a map; show the address as text only
No online payment; orders are collected at the shop
Do not make up any detail not in the brief
done_when: The page shows the name Brew Lab and the address 12, 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 as text, with no embedded map.
The page lists all seven menu items with their rupee prices: Filter coffee 90, Cappuccino 160, Latte 180, Cold brew 200, Masala chai 80, Almond croissant 140, Banana bread slice 120.
The page has a pre-order form with the fields name, phone, items and pickup time, and the form sends the order to hello@brewlab.example.
The page says customers collect the order at the shop and that no online payment is taken.
The page shows no opening hours and no shop phone number.
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
visitor_needs: See the shop name and address
Pre-order for pickup at the shop
